title: 1987 Topps Spring Fever Baseball Sweepstakes Special Offer Card Unused Insert
condition_description: Near mint or better; entry form on the back is blank and unused. See photos.
description:
1987 Topps "Spring Fever Baseball" sweepstakes and special offer insert card from 1987 Topps baseball packs - win a trip for 4 to 1988 Spring Training. Back has the official rules, the 1987 Collector's Edition All Stars & Hot Prospects mail-in offer, and the entry form, which is blank and unused.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
